verdict.rationale: Increase documents per-version Entity validations exposed via the API and tells the platform to follow up with its customer when a validation flags a data issue. That is a thin, first-party signal for seeing why an onboarding record has problems, and a hint at who acts on it. Missing for 10: a documented onboarding queue or pending-application status view, a way to supply or upload additional documents, an explicit split of which decisions belong to the platform versus the bank, and any dashboard or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can work the onboarding queue — see why an application is pending, supply additional documents, and understand which decisions are mine versus the bank's

citations.quote: Increase makes Entity validations available via the API for each version of the data. You should follow up with your customer when the validation indicates a data issue.
You represent each of your customers as an Entity. Entities are the foundation for everything else here.
